title: Neodustria Phase 23.2 Causal Memory Transfer Benchmark (7 Arms)
benchmark_scope: 3 Severe Physical Regimes (Task 01, Task 12, Task 15) evaluated under strict physical gates

Arm_B_Muse_Raw_History.name: Muse with Raw Uncurated History
Arm_B_Muse_Raw_History.finding: Raw evaluation logs confuse the model with thousands of numerical tokens without causal synthesis.

Arm_C_Muse_Validated_Principles.name: Muse with Validated Principles (No Counterexamples)
Arm_C_Muse_Validated_Principles.finding: Principles steer toward symmetric shuttles, but model still occasionally selects prone fixed-guided designs.

Arm_E_Deterministic_CASM_No_Muse.name: Deterministic CASM Rules (No LLM Model Calls)
Arm_E_Deterministic_CASM_No_Muse.finding: Hardcoded CASM rules deterministically select the multi-stage folded shuttle, matching full Neodustria.

Arm_F_Classical_Symbolic_GP_Search.name: Classical Symbolic Regression + GP Search
Arm_F_Classical_Symbolic_GP_Search.finding: Discovers power-law scaling but requires multiple FEA calls to discover valid topology.

Arm_G_Full_Neodustria_Scientist.name: Full Neodustria Scientist (GP-First + CASM + Muse)
Arm_G_Full_Neodustria_Scientist.finding: Achieves 100% feasibility with rich causal explanation and verified physical convergence.

causal_attribution_summary.causal_effect_of_casm_counterexamples: Improves single-shot proposal feasibility from 0% (Cold Muse: 0/3) to 100% (CASM Muse: 3/3) by explicitly warning against axial tension locking in single-stage beams.
causal_attribution_summary.causal_effect_of_muse_vs_deterministic: Deterministic CASM (Arm E) matches Full Neodustria (Arm G) at 100% feasibility. Muse's genuine value lies in generating structural hypotheses and explaining physical failure modes to the engineer.
